title: Fatima Alvarez to represent PH at Mrs. Universe: ‘I want to win’
summary: Later this month, Mrs. Universe Philippines 2026 Fatima Figueroa Alvarez will travel to Colombo, Sri Lanka, to compete in the 49th Mrs. Universe beauty pageant.
